problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify CircularAreaInit against current CRTOS commit d1a2bbc0 and the synchronized INPUT source. The target executable body must match INPUT/xizi/xizi_circular_area_init/xizi_circular_area_init.c except the already-authorized omission of KPrintf. The descriptor-allocation failure returns null without freeing null; the backing-buffer allocation failure frees the descriptor and returns null.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For supported requests 4 through 256, allocation may fail cleanly with return 0 and emp. On success, return a non-null descriptor whose aligned capacity is floor(requested/4)*4, whose readidx/writeidx/status are zero, whose logical FIFO is nil, and whose freshly allocated physical buffer is mixed_full with repeat None.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Do not change production executable semantics beyond synchronizing the exact latest Init failure-cleanup statements from the declared INPUT. Failure leaves emp. Success establishes the shared CircularAreaBackingResource and composes with downstream APIs.
spec_hint: Define a readable Init-specific success predicate in the case_lib if useful; keep CircularAreaBackingResource as the shared reusable representation. Use UCharArray.mixed_full with repeat None, reached from allocator undef_full. Use precondition 4 <= requested <= 256.
preferred_hidden_properties: Fresh Init is distinct from Reset: logical is nil and every physical option cell is None.
forbidden_patterns: Do not retain CircularAreaInitFailureResource as a leaked-descriptor postcondition for current CRTOS.
Do not derive UCharArray.full from undef_full or mixed_full.
Do not claim the implementation rejects requests greater than 256; the supported-domain bound is a caller precondition.

anti_patterns_avoided: No algorithm mirror or state-machine definition.
No claim that the implementation runtime-rejects requests greater than 256.
hidden_properties: Failure returns null with emp on both allocation-failure paths.
Success aligns capacity to floor(requested/4)*4 for 4 <= requested <= 256.
Fresh Init has readidx=writeidx=status=0 and logical FIFO nil.
Fresh physical storage is UCharArray.mixed_full with repeat None, obtained from allocator undef_full rather than UCharArray.full.
known_risks: Canonical generation is expected to leave one success return_checker witness connecting undef_full, repeat None, aligned arithmetic, and CircularAreaBackingResource; qcp-mcp reports this exact witness and no failure-path witness.
